meta.title: Durga Puja
meta.description: Programmes, music, results and everything for our community Durga Puja.

footer.about: Our community's celebration of Maa Durga — programmes, music, games and memories for everyone.
footer.madeWith: Made with love for our Puja family.

home.subtitle: Five days of dhak, dhunuchi and togetherness. Join our programmes, sing along, vote for little artists and celebrate with the whole para.
home.programmesTitle: Programmes you can be part of
home.mahalayaBody: The morning that begins it all. Listen to Mahishasuramardini and our curated playlist of Agomoni, Dhunuchi and Puja favourites.
home.aboutBody: The story, the rituals and the meaning behind the biggest festival of Bengal — why, what and when we celebrate.
home.donateBody: Scan the QR code and donate. Every contribution helps us bring Maa home.

donate.title: Donate to the Puja
donate.description: Your generosity makes the pandal, the bhog and the programmes possible.
donate.step1: Open any UPI app — Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or your bank app.
donate.step2: Scan the QR code (or use the UPI ID below).
donate.step3: Enter any amount you wish, add your name in the note, and pay.
donate.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please copy it manually.
donate.disclaimer: Always check that the payee name matches the Puja committee before paying.
